description:
pattern     timeline-split / process
surface     dark
kit         none
form        Columns 1–5 feature a narrative anchor analyzing the transition from academic theory to technical autonomy; columns 6–12 display a 4-stage vertical evolution card sequence with cyan status indicators, stage headers, and descriptive overviews. On mobile, cards stack sequentially beneath the section title.
copy
  eyebrow      CAPABILITY ROADMAP
  heading      Skill Evolution
  intro        The trajectory was never linear. It required unlearning rigid assumptions and continuously building the resilience to master unfamiliar stacks.
  stage-1-name Learning
  stage-1-desc  Building rock-solid computer science fundamentals — data structures, object-oriented principles, database schemas, and networking essentials.
  stage-2-name Building
  stage-2-desc  Transitioning into real-world software engineering — constructing robust APIs, crafting fluid user interfaces, and managing state across modern stacks.
  stage-3-name Leading
  stage-3-desc  Mastering collaborative delivery — running code reviews, establishing CI/CD automation pipelines, resolving architectural trade-offs, and unblocking teammates.
  stage-4-name Professional
  stage-4-desc  Engineering production-grade systems — optimizing database bottlenecks, ensuring security compliance, and maintaining scalable cloud infrastructures.
motion      Stage cards reveal with translate-X 15px at 100ms intervals tied to scroll progression.
plan check  heading placed; 4-stage progression (Learning, Building, Leading, Professional) each with a short description placed.
layout_description: Two-column asymmetric layout with left explanatory narrative and right vertical progression card track.
